about: Kinds of regular enemy and where their decks come from (rpg/enemies.py). Names and colours are placeholders until the first region's content is written; Karl's to change. format/archetypes: Forge's archetype data (res/deckgendecks/<format>.raw.dat). decks: how many decks each kind ships. max_tier: no card above it (rpg/tiers.py; null = no cap).

kinds.name: Drowned Cultist
kinds.note: Every Pauper faerie list Forge built holds Counterspell, Spell Pierce or Preordain, which the archetype data puts in tier 5; with a cap of 4 none passed (12 of 12 turned down, 12 Oct).

kinds.name: Wild Elf
kinds.note: Every Pauper elf list holds Llanowar Elves or Elvish Mystic, tier 5 in the archetype data; with a cap of 4 none of 12 passed (12 Oct). Under the 'once-common at most 4' tier option they would be tier 4.

kinds.name: Hive Spawn
kinds.note: Forge's builder often makes another archetype for this one (3 of 4 builds on 12 Oct), so it gets more tries.

kinds.name: Grave Priest
kinds.note: Replaces a blue-black kind: every Pauper blue-black list Forge built held Brainstorm 2-4 times (restricted) and tier-5 Counterspell (12 of 12 turned down, 12 Oct).
